feeds.title: Diary of a Sewing Fanatic
feeds.description: Carolyn is a sewist, dressmaker, fabricaholic and creative fiber artist, who loves to sew and has made everything from her wedding outfit, to coats, her daughter's and grandchildren's clothing as well a couple of home dec items.

feeds.title: Raven Maureen
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Raven, I'm a sewing, fashion and DIY lover based in Jackson, MS. My love for sewing started at a young age, but it wasn't until I took a clothing design class in high school that I learned a lot of technical details of sewing and garment construction. Since I started my blog, I've been sewing more consistently than ever before and my closet is about 80% handmade!

feeds.title: That Black Chic
feeds.description: This is a Sewing & DIY blog. Sharing sewing tutorials, DIY, Interior Design, Sewing, and today's fashions. My name is Michelle. My background is in Fashion Design but I love anything to do with art. When it comes to interior designing I like to design on a budget. I can't always afford all the grand things in life but I do have a way of creating alternative options that fit my budget.

feeds.title: The Tell Tale Tasha
feeds.description: I named this blog 'The Telltale Tasha' because I not only want to share and enjoy my journey with anyone that wants to come along, but I also want my blog to serve as a source of information.

feeds.title: The Corny Rainbow
feeds.description: Greetings! My name is Nefertiti, aka The Corny Rainbow. I am a creative who also sews a lot, a surface designer, and artist who loves colorful fashion, unicorns, and rainbows. I am a lover of all things DIY (mostly sewing). If I'm shopping, it's usually for fabric...my stash is sick! I also love stripes, florals, shimmer, and colorful textiles.

feeds.title: Seams Like Sierra Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog, Seams Like Sierra. This is a place where I talk about all things sewing, making, knitting, crafting, and really just life in general. I'm Sierra, and I'm a lot of things. I am a black woman, a daughter, a veterinarian, a dreamer, and a hopeless romantic. I currently live in the Atlanta area.

feeds.title: Erica Bunker
feeds.description: Erica Bunker, DIY Style is a fashion sewing blog that was established in 2005. Erica loves inspiring others who enjoy creating their own wardrobe through the art of sewing. Erica demonstrates how she pulls inspiration from the runway and luxury brands to create beautifully tailored, designer-quality, classic garments with couture details and a contemporary twist.

feeds.title: Oonaballoona
feeds.description: Covers sewing thoughts, tools, sewing machine tips, fabrics, patterns and more. Marcy Harriell is an actress, but her alter ego Oonaballoona is a sewist! Catch both of their adventures.

feeds.title: Miss Celie's Pants
feeds.description: My name is Renee and I sew. A lot. I live with my husband Jordan, an assortment of knitting/sewing machines and more fabric than I can sew in this lifetime. I have always loved clothes but thankfully had parents who refused to spend $75 on a pair of GAP jeans. So, I learned to sew. And, I think ANYBODY with a little patience, can learn to sew! I pretty much taught myself from books, and with the Internet, it has got to be easier!

feeds.title: That's Sew Monica Blog
feeds.description: I am Monica of That's Sew Monica. I am originally from the Bronx, NY with roots from Ghana, West Africa. I started sewing to honor my mother's legacy after the 10 year anniversary of her passing. I actually come from a lineage of sewers in my family.

feeds.title: Michelle Sews Blog
feeds.description: Michelle Sews is an emerging British independent sewing pattern label. We design contemporary takes on classic garments, and aim for each pattern to be a 'wardrobe builder' - one that can be made repeatedly to build an elegant business casual wardrobe.
